Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Bernard Bresnahan <bern...@YAHOO.COM> wrote:
> In Yesterday's list you answered a question re: Actions and
> blood costs for someone else. I believe it went like this;
>
> Anson with 1 blood attempts to use Legal manipulations for +2 Bleed.
> Anson then uses Aire of Elations, leaving him unable to pay for
> the Legal Manip. The action then fizzles.
>
> Okay, I understand all that.
>
> My question: Assuming the action is not blocked even though Anson
> has fizzled his Legal Man. would he still get the base bleed of 1
> against his target? Or does simply nothing happen except that Anson
> taps? Ack!

It does nothing. A fizzled action does not revert to some "base"
action type. It just fizzles. (And Anson is left tapped).
